name: stepper
summary: Ordered multi-step progress indicator for checkout flows, onboarding wizards, and any experience that needs to show where the user is in a sequence of up to six steps. Mirrors the LifeLock-themed master variant set on [Web-ODS Shared Library / 1386:867](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=1386-867&m=dev) and the companion [Spec Frame `1386:1325`](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=1386-1325&m=dev).

properties.name: showStep2
properties.description: When `false`, step 2 and its connector are omitted.

properties.name: step<N>State
properties.description: One of `default` / `active` / `complete` for steps 1–6. Active step should carry `aria-current="step"`.

properties.name: step<N>ShowLabel
properties.description: When `true`, renders the label slot below (horizontal) or beside (vertical) the indicator.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Optional `aria-label` on the `<ol>` root when labels are hidden.

properties.name: steps[].state
properties.description: Helper-derived. Per-step state (`default` / `active` / `complete`) the stories layer flattens from `step<N>State`; drives `.c-stepper__step--state-<state>`.

properties.name: steps[].showLabel
properties.description: Helper-derived from `step<N>ShowLabel`; gates the label slot.

properties.name: steps[].label
properties.description: Helper-derived from `step<N>Label`; the visible label text.

properties.name: steps[].showConnector
properties.description: Helper-derived. Emits the decorative connector after every step except the last.

properties.name: steps[].number
properties.description: Helper-derived from `step<N>Number`; the indicator digit for non-complete steps.

variants.values: `horizontal` (default) / `vertical`. Drives `.c-stepper--direction-<direction>`. Horizontal distributes steps evenly across the inline axis (every step with a trailing connector grows; the final step hugs its content). Vertical stacks steps with 80 px row height between connectors.

`default` / `active` / `complete`. Drives `.c-stepper__step--state-<state>`. Not a Figma variant axis on the Stepper container — applied per Step instance (`1386:803`). Interaction is presentation-only; the consumer sets which step is active by passing markup/state props.
Boolean visibility toggles on the Stepper container (`1386:867`). Step 1 is always visible. Hidden steps are omitted from the DOM and the accessibility tree.

accessibility: Root renders as `<ol>`; each step is `<li>`.
When step labels are hidden, supply `ariaLabel` on the root.
Steps hidden via `showStep2` … `showStep6` are removed from the DOM
